scope: Frozen label-conditioned reconstruction and saved-output oracle diagnostics; no new training or free generation.

prefix_oracle.interpretation: Oracle swaps in saved trajectories; prefix edits may create a junction at the edit endpoint. Not achievable generated quality.

decoder_sensitivity.interpretation: Whole-horizon linear coupling. Signed vectors may cancel; RMS components do not add.

verification.pooled_percentile_note: Per-frame arrays are not stored in reconstruction row summaries; pooled quantiles are source-run outputs, not percentiles of scene quantiles.

limits: Single fixed Gaussian per window reused over timesteps and candidates.
Denoising reconstruction accesses known future labels; it is not label-free generation.
Train controls are a small metadata-selected cohort; geometry/episode/domain composition may confound split differences.
Oracle prefix edits use labels and may transfer error to a later junction.
No training loss, threshold, decoder, sampling protocol or dataset change.
Train probe overrepresents dense scenes; split totals are not distribution-matched.
Oracle field substitutions use true future states and cannot be used as a baseline or inference repair.
Suggested loss reweighting and denser training emphasis remain untrained candidates.
